content: Self-hosted Kodi repository failure modes. Kodi decides whether to re-read addons.xml by comparing the remote addons.xml.md5 against the md5 it stored at last check; 'Check for updates' / force refresh invalidates the stored md5 and re-downloads. If addons.xml.md5 is not regenerated (or is regenerated with a trailing newline / different line endings than what Kodi hashes) the repo appears frozen and add-on updates silently never arrive, while a manual force-refresh works - the classic symptom of a broken auto-update. Reported GitHub-raw specific failure: Kodi's CFileCache opening the md5 over a raw.githubusercontent.com URL logging 'Source read didn't return any data!', i.e. CDN caching / range-request behaviour on raw URLs interacting badly with Kodi's file cache. Other reported causes: repository mirrors that omit addons.xml.md5 entirely, and oversized cache buffers in advancedsettings.xml causing 'Failed to fetch checksum {addons.xml} for repository'. Version comparison is Debian-style; Kodi only offers an update when the repo version is strictly greater, so a version that sorts lower (or equal) blocks updates. Workaround users fall back to is uninstall + reinstall from zip.
